# tScrub

> tScrub is an open, auditable disk-sanitisation tool for regulated IT. It erases NVMe, SATA, and SCSI drives to NIST 800-88 Clear, Purge, and Destroy levels and produces a verifiable chain-of-custody report. Boot the ready-to-go tScrub appliance image from USB or PXE on hardware you already own.

## Pages

- [Home](https://tscrub.com/): Overview, value proposition, features, and audiences.
- [Getting started](https://tscrub.com/getting-started): The full journey — account, licence, download, boot, wipe, report, certificate, verify.
- [How it works](https://tscrub.com/how-it-works): From boot to certificate — the four-step sanitisation walkthrough.
- [Compliance](https://tscrub.com/compliance): How each wipe method maps to NIST 800-88 Clear, Purge, and Destroy, with GDPR/HIPAA/ISO 27001 reporting.
- [Compare](https://tscrub.com/compare): tScrub vs Blancco — same compliance outcome, no vendor lock-in.
- [Pricing](https://tscrub.com/pricing): Free community build, Pay-as-you-go £3/device, Team £99 (100 credits), Enterprise £399 (500 credits) — free licences are self-serve; paid licences are issued by tScrub.
- [Download](https://tscrub.com/download): The bootable appliance ISO, with a SHA-256 checksum for verification.
- [Docs](https://tscrub.com/docs): Building the appliance, booting from USB (Windows/macOS/Linux) or over the network (PXE), choosing a report destination (USB, FTP, or the tScrub dashboard), and verifying signed reports.
- [Resources](https://tscrub.com/resources): Data erasure guides — standards, drive types, wipe methods, certificates of destruction, and a buyer's guide.
- [Updates](https://tscrub.com/updates): Product updates and release notes.
- [FAQ](https://tscrub.com/faq): Certification, build-your-own-appliance, and edge-case drive handling.
- [Certificates](https://tscrub.com/dashboard/certificates): Upload reports on the Reports page, then select a Chain of Custody ID to generate one consolidated, printable Certificate of Destruction per job, and manage every certificate on your account.
- [Reports](https://tscrub.com/dashboard/reports): Upload reports and view erasure and pre/post-wipe SMART data for every report — uploaded manually or pushed from an appliance.
- [Contact](https://tscrub.com/contact): Sales, support, and compliance enquiries.

## Key facts

- Supports NVMe (crypto, block, overwrite sanitise + format fallback), ATA (enhanced/standard secure erase), and SCSI sanitise.
- Handles SED/OPAL drives via PSID revert and detects BIOS Block SID lockdown (0x4286).
- Chain-of-custody report (CSV) with COCID, system serials, and per-drive final status.
- Reports can be signed (SHA-256 + Ed25519) for verifiable proof of destruction.
- NIST 800-88 alignment, GDPR, HIPAA, ISO 27001.
- Single self-contained Bash script; inspect every line.
